scenarios.title: Bevasarlas a vacsorahoz
scenarios.situation: A lakotarsad, Balazs, a boltban van, es uzenetet kuld, hogy mit kell venni a mai vacsorahoz.
scenarios.situationEn: Your flatmate, Balazs, is at the shop and messages you asking what to buy for dinner today.
scenarios.targetCompetency: I can write short, simple notes and messages relating to everyday matters

turns.interlocutorPrompt: Szia! Eppen a boltban vagyok. Kell venni valamit vacsorara?
turns.interlocutorTranslation: Hi! I am at the store right now. Do we need to buy anything for dinner?
turns.learnerCue: Koszond a Balazst, es ird meg neki, hogy kenyer, sajt es paradicsom kell.
turns.learnerCueEn: Greet Balazs and write to him that we need bread, cheese, and tomatoes.
vocabularyHints: Szia Balazs! — Hi Balazs!
Kell kenyer es sajt. — We need bread and cheese.
Kerlek vegyel paradicsomot is. — Please buy tomatoes too.
Koszonom! — Thank you!

turns.interlocutorPrompt: Rendben, a kenyeret es a sajtot mar a kosarba tettem. Vegyek valami innivalot is, peldaul asvanyvizet vagy almalevet?
turns.interlocutorTranslation: Alright, I already put bread and cheese in the basket. Should I buy something to drink too, like mineral water or apple juice?
turns.learnerCue: Kerj egy nagy uveg asvanyvizet es almalevet.
turns.learnerCueEn: Ask for a big bottle of mineral water and apple juice.
vocabularyHints: Igen, kerlek vegyel asvanyvizet. — Yes, please buy mineral water.
Egy nagy uveg vizet. — A big bottle of water.
Es almalevet is. — And apple juice too.

turns.interlocutorPrompt: Szuper, most megyek a penztarhoz. Körülbelül tiz perc mulva otthon vagyok. Megterited az asztalt?
turns.interlocutorTranslation: Super, heading to checkout now. I will be home in about ten minutes. Will you set the table?
turns.learnerCue: Valaszolj, hogy igen, szivesen megterited az asztalt, es varod otthon.
turns.learnerCueEn: Answer yes, you will gladly set the table and wait for him at home.
vocabularyHints: Igen, megteritem az asztalt. — Yes, I will set the table.
Szivesen! — Gladly!
Varom itthon! — Waiting for you at home!
Szia! — Bye!

scenarios.title: Talalkozo a Deak teren
scenarios.situation: Ot orakor talalkozol a baratoddal, Annaval a Deak Ferenc teren, de a metrod kesik es uzenetet irsz.
scenarios.situationEn: You are meeting your friend Anna at 5:00 at Deak Ferenc ter, but your metro is delayed and you text her.
scenarios.targetCompetency: I can exchange basic text messages to arrange meeting times and locations

turns.interlocutorPrompt: Szia! Mar itt vagyok a Deak teren a templom elott. Hol jarsz?
turns.interlocutorTranslation: Hi! I am already here at Deak square in front of the church. Where are you?
turns.learnerCue: Kerd elnezest es ird meg, hogy kesik a metro, tiz perc mulva megerkezel.
turns.learnerCueEn: Apologize and write that the metro is delayed, you will arrive in ten minutes.
vocabularyHints: Szia Anna, ne haragudj! — Hi Anna, don't be angry / sorry!
Kesik a metro. — The metro is delayed.
Tiz perc mulva ott vagyok. — I will be there in ten minutes.
Bocsánat! — Sorry!

turns.interlocutorPrompt: Semmi baj, nem sietunk! Kicsit hideg van kint. Bemenjek a sarkon levo kavezoba?
turns.interlocutorTranslation: No problem, no hurry! It is a bit cold outside. Should I go into the corner cafe?
turns.learnerCue: Valaszolj, hogy az nagyon jo otlet, menjen be nyugodtan.
turns.learnerCueEn: Reply that it is a very good idea, tell her to go ahead inside.
vocabularyHints: Igen, jo otlet! — Yes, good idea!
Menj be nyugodtan. — Go inside by all means.
Mindjart ott vagyok. — I will be there shortly.

turns.interlocutorPrompt: Mar leultem az ablak melle. Kerjek neked egy kavet vagy teat, mire megerkezel?
turns.interlocutorTranslation: I am already seated next to the window. Should I order you a coffee or tea before you arrive?
turns.learnerCue: Koszond meg es kerj egy meleg tejeskavet.
turns.learnerCueEn: Thank her and ask for a warm coffee with milk.
vocabularyHints: Nagyon koszonom! — Thank you very much!
Egy meleg tejeskavet kerek. — A warm latte/white coffee please.
Mindjart megerkezem. — Arriving right now.

scenarios.title: Apartman kulcsatvetel
scenarios.situation: Hetvegere szallast bereltel Budapesten, de a vonattal kesesben vagy es uzenetet irsz a tulajdonosnak, Tamasnak.
scenarios.situationEn: You booked accommodation in Budapest for the weekend, but your train is delayed and you message the host, Tamas.
scenarios.targetCompetency: I can communicate travel delays and coordinate check-in procedures in writing

turns.interlocutorPrompt: Udvozlom! Erdeklodom, hogy meg mindig het orakor erkezik a lakasba a kulcsok atvetelere?
turns.interlocutorTranslation: Greetings! Inquiring if you are still arriving at seven o'clock for the key handover?
turns.learnerCue: Udvozold Tamast, es magyarazd el, hogy a vonatod kesik, igy varhatoan fel kilencre ersz oda.
turns.learnerCueEn: Greet Tamas and explain that your train is delayed, so you expect to arrive around 8:30.
vocabularyHints: Jo napot kivanok Tamas! — Good day Tamas!
Sajnos kesik a vonatunk. — Unfortunately our train is delayed.
Varhatoan fel kilencre erunk oda. — Expected to arrive around eight thirty.
Elnézést a kellemetlensegert. — Sorry for the inconvenience.

turns.interlocutorPrompt: Semmi gond, megesik az ilyesmi. Fel kilenckor nem tudok ott lenni, de a kulcsszefbe beteszem a kulcsot a bejaratnal. Megfelel igy onnek?
turns.interlocutorTranslation: No problem, these things happen. At 8:30 I cannot be there, but I will put the key in the key safe by the entrance. Does that suit you?
turns.learnerCue: Valaszolj, hogy ez tokeletesen megfelel, es kerdezd meg a kulcsszef kodjat.
turns.learnerCueEn: Answer that this suits you perfectly, and ask for the code to the key safe.
vocabularyHints: Ez tokeletes megoldas, koszonom! — This is a perfect solution, thank you!
Mi a kulcsszef kodja? — What is the key safe code?
Hogyan mukodik? — How does it work?

turns.interlocutorPrompt: A kod: 5291. Kinyitas utan kerem tekerje el a szamokat. Jo utat, es kerem irjon, ha megerkeztek!
turns.interlocutorTranslation: The code is 5291. After opening please spin the numbers. Safe travels, and please write when you have arrived!
turns.learnerCue: Koszond meg a segitokeszseget es ird meg, hogy szolsz amint bent vagytok az apartmanban.
turns.learnerCueEn: Thank him for his helpfulness and write that you will let him know as soon as you are inside the apartment.
vocabularyHints: Koszonom szepen a segitseget! — Thank you very much for the help!
Kod feljegyezve. — Code noted down.
Uzenek amint megerkezunk. — I will message as soon as we arrive.
Koszonom! — Thank you!

scenarios.title: Idopont-egyeztetes orvosnal
scenarios.situation: Faj a hatad es uzenetet irsz a maganrendelo recepciosanak idopont modositasa miatt.
scenarios.situationEn: Your back hurts and you message the private clinic receptionist to reschedule your appointment.
scenarios.targetCompetency: I can reschedule appointments and describe physical symptoms in simple written notes

turns.interlocutorPrompt: Jo napot kivanok! Az Eletrendelo recepciója fogadja az uzenetet. Miben segithetunk?
turns.interlocutorTranslation: Good day! Eletrendelo clinic reception here. How can we help you?
turns.learnerCue: Udvozold a recepcionistat, ird meg, hogy pentekre van idopontod, de sajnos at kell tenned a jovo hetre.
turns.learnerCueEn: Greet the receptionist, say you have an appointment for Friday, but unfortunately need to move it to next week.
vocabularyHints: Jo napot kivanok! — Good day!
Idopontom van pentekre. — I have an appointment for Friday.
Szeretnem athelyezni a jovo hetre. — I would like to reschedule to next week.
Erosen faj a hatam. — My back hurts badly.

turns.interlocutorPrompt: Ertem. A jovo heten kedd delelott tiz orakor vagy csutortok delutan haromkor tudna fogadni a szakorvos. Melyik lenne jobb onnek?
turns.interlocutorTranslation: Understood. Next week the specialist can see you Tuesday morning at 10:00 or Thursday afternoon at 3:00. Which would be better for you?
turns.learnerCue: Valaszd a kedd delelott tiz orai idopontot es ird meg, hogy az tokeletes szamodra.
turns.learnerCueEn: Choose the Tuesday 10:00 AM slot and write that it is perfect for you.
vocabularyHints: A kedd delelott tiz ora tokeletes lenne. — Tuesday 10 AM would be perfect.
Azt szeretnem kerni. — I would like to request that one.
Koszonom szepen. — Thank you very much.

turns.interlocutorPrompt: Rögzitettem: jovo kedd 10:00. Kerjuk, hogy az elozo orvosi leleteit hozza magaval a vizsgalatra! Varjuk onoket.
turns.interlocutorTranslation: Recorded: next Tuesday 10:00. Please bring your previous medical records to the exam! We look forward to seeing you.
turns.learnerCue: Koszond meg a segitseget es ird meg, hogy magaddal viszed a leleteket.
turns.learnerCueEn: Thank them for the help and write that you will bring the medical records with you.
vocabularyHints: Koszonom szepen a segitseget! — Thank you very much for the help!
Termeszetesen viszem a leleteket. — Of course I will bring the records.
Viszontlatasra! — Goodbye!
